questions.text: Describe a time when you spoke in front of a group of people.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you spoke in front of a group of people. You should say: when and where it was; who was listening; what you talked about; and explain how you felt while you were speaking.

questions.text: Would you feel the same if you had to do it again?
questions.say: Thank you. Would you feel the same if you had to do it again?

questions.text: Why are many people nervous about speaking in public?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you spoke in front of a group of people, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all public speaking. Why are many people nervous about speaking in public?
